## What does this PR do?

A clear and concise description of the change.

## Related issue

Fixes #issue-number, or "No issue yet".

## Which area does it touch?

- [ ] New video mode (a new `videoType`)
- [ ] Bug fix for an existing mode
- [ ] Pipeline / workflow improvement
- [ ] Studio UI / frontend
- [ ] API / render server
- [ ] Docs / repo housekeeping

## How was it tested?

Describe how you verified the change. For mode changes, include:

- The `videoType` and payload you submitted (or a link to the payload).
- The `jobId` and whether the job reached `completed`.
- Screenshots or the output video URL, if available.

Checklist before submitting:

- [ ] Ran `npm run lint`
- [ ] Ran `npx tsc --noEmit`
- [ ] Tested the affected mode end to end (or explained why not)
- [ ] No real API keys or secrets are included anywhere in the PR

## Additional context

Anything else reviewers should know.
